info.title: Sodapop API
info.summary: Soda check-in API with a narrow read-only public preview
info.description: Sodapop exposes an intentionally narrow API. There is no endpoint that lists the whole catalog, all users or all venues. Catalog access is limited to single-drink reads, an authenticated search capped at 10 results, and barcode resolution. Social reads are limited to your own data and accepted friends. The only anonymous data routes are the read-only public preview (public check-ins from authors who opted into a public profile) and the public drink fact sheet. All member data endpoints require a personal `sd_` bearer token; requests are rate limited per token or per IP for the public preview. Check-ins can optionally be marked at_home, which uses one shared hidden @home venue; Sodapop never stores or returns a home coordinate. Nearby venue search can opt into external Photon (OpenStreetMap) results with source=external|all and consent=true.

bearerAuth.description: Personal API token created in Settings, or exchanged by the Android app via `/api/v1/auth/mobile-token`. Scopes: read, write, feed.

rating_display.description: Quarter-star rating as stars with up to two decimals, or an em dash when unrated.

when.description: Short relative label, e.g. 2h ago, 3d ago or Nov 8.

NearbyFeedItem.description: Shares FeedItem's fields except lat, lng and tagged_friends, which the nearby feed omits so a location response cannot expose raw device coordinates.

venue_id.description: Venue the check-in was logged at.

distance_m.description: Distance to the venue, bucketed down to 100 m so responses cannot be used for metre-level triangulation.

rating_shown.description: Averages are shown only after 3 distinct raters.

idempotency_key.description: Replaying the same key returns the original check-in.

lat.description: Raw device latitude. Must be sent together with lng.

lng.description: Raw device longitude. Must be sent together with lat.

friend_ids.description: Accepted friend user IDs to tag. Duplicates and the author's own id are ignored.

at_home.description: Mark the check-in at the shared hidden @home venue. Mutually exclusive with venue_id. Coordinates are ignored and never stored.

user_id.description: Author id. Handles are in `user`; ids are stable for deletion checks.

can_delete.description: True when the viewer authored the comment or is a moderator.

edited_at.description: Last author edit of the body. Omitted when the comment was never edited.

image.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF; 25 MiB total request body.

comments_count.description: Live comments only; deleted comments and deleted authors are excluded.

saved.description: True when the authenticated viewer has bookmarked this check-in.

at_home.description: True for the shared hidden @home marker.

price_cents.description: Amount paid in minor units, or null when no price was recorded.

price_currency.description: ISO-4217 code for price_cents; empty when the unit is unknown.

edited_at.description: Last author edit of the check-in. Omitted when it was never edited.

sparse.description: True for a year with fewer than five check-ins.

years_with_data.description: Every year the member has at least one countable check-in, ascending. Soft-deleted check-ins and merged drinks do not count, so each year here has something to show.

badges.description: Badges awarded inside this recap year (UTC), ordered by badge slug like the badge list endpoint.

whole_history.description: True when the axes cover the member's whole history rather than the recap year. Always true today: the fingerprint has no year window.

score.description: 0–100, normalised to the member's own strongest category.

friend_request_id.description: Present only for an incoming pending friend request.

ListItemInput.description: Supply either drink_id or slug. Re-adding a drink already in the list returns the existing item.

current.description: Always false for bearer-token requests, which have no browser session cookie.

at_home.description: True for the shared hidden @home marker.

FavouriteDrink.description: A compact card for the drink pinned to a profile.

at_home.description: True for the shared hidden @home marker.

VenueShelfEntry.description: One drink on a venue's shelf, merged from member reports and recent check-ins.

price_cents.description: Amount in minor units. Sodapop has no currency concept; treat as unitless.

mine.description: True when the caller has a live stock report for this drink at this venue.

report_id.description: The caller's own report id, or null. Another member's id is never returned.

VenueShelfReport.description: A member's report that a drink is on a venue's shelf.

price_cents.description: Amount in minor units. Sodapop has no currency concept; treat as unitless.

seen_at.description: When the drink was seen, RFC 3339. Omit to mean "seen just now".

friend_checkins.description: Tell me when a friend checks in a wishlisted drink.

venue_shelf.description: Tell me when a saved venue reports a wishlisted drink in stock.

CheckinUpdateInput.description: Any subset of the editable fields. An absent field is left untouched; sending null for rating, venue_id or price_cents clears it. Unknown fields are rejected. Only the author may edit, and only while the check-in is inside its 24-hour edit window.

venue_id.description: Venue id. Null clears the venue; omit to keep it.

price_cents.description: Amount paid in minor units. Null clears the price.

price_currency.description: ISO-4217 code, upper-cased on write. Empty means the unit is unknown. Cleared with the price when price_cents is null and no currency is sent.

last_notified_at.description: When a drop alert last fired for this search; null until the first one.

SavedSearchInput.description: At least one filter must be set: an unfiltered search would alert on every catalog drop. Empty strings mean "any".

name.description: Optional label. Derived from the filters when blank.

query.description: Free text matched, case-insensitively, against the drink name, brand and description. Empty means any.

style_slug.description: Catalog style slug. Empty means any. Existence is not checked, so a search can be saved before the style has a drink.

brand_slug.description: Catalog brand slug. Empty means any.

flavour_slug.description: Catalog flavour slug, matched against the drink's flavours. Empty means any.

caffeine_free.description: Only drinks with 0 mg caffeine per 100 ml.

sugar_free.description: Only drinks with 0 g sugar per 100 ml.

notify_drops.description: Send a drop alert when a matching drink enters the catalog. Defaults to true when omitted.

avatar_url.description: Authenticated media route for the avatar, or null when the member has none.

followed_by_viewer.description: True when the authenticated viewer follows this member.

is_friend.description: True when the viewer and this member are accepted friends.

Lifetime counters plus the current and longest check-in day streaks. Self only.

One member's calendar-year aggregate: totals, leaders, rating distribution, palate shift and flavour fingerprint. The window is [1 January, 1 January next year) in UTC. A year with no check-ins returns 200 with has_data false; it is not a 404. Self only.

get.summary: Your sugar, caffeine and calorie insights
get.description: Derived from your own non-deleted check-ins and the drink nutrition facts per 100 ml. Self only.
Most recent 50 notifications for the token owner. Each row carries a safe relative `href` and, for an incoming pending friend request, a `friend_request_id`. No totals are returned.

Server-sent events for the token owner, the mobile counterpart of the web `/notifications/stream`. The stream opens with an `unread` event carrying `{"count":N}`, forwards each visible notification as a `notification` event with the same `id`, `kind`, `text`, `href`, `subject_id`, `created_at` and `read` fields as the inbox, and sends `close` roughly every 30 minutes so the client reconnects. Blocked actors and deleted rows are never announced; a `: keep-alive` comment keeps idle connections open. Deliveries are pushed from an in-process bus, with a periodic reconciliation read as a fallback.

200.description: An SSE stream of `unread`, `notification` and `close` events

post.description: Omit `id` to mark everything read.

get.description: Returns check-ins from you and accepted friends only. There is no global or public feed.

Returns visible check-ins at venues within the requested radius of a caller-supplied point. Only your own, accepted friends' and followed users' visible check-ins are eligible; strangers' private check-ins are never returned. The point is not stored or echoed. Distances are bucketed down to 100 m and pagination uses an opaque cursor.

parameters.description: Search radius in kilometres.

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from meta.next_before.

get.description: Requires at least 2 characters. By default returns at most 10 drink results, with no cursor or total. get.description: Normalizes to GTIN-14, then checks the local catalog, the Open Food Facts cache, and finally Open Food Facts itself. OFF data is returned as an attributed suggestion, never merged into the catalog automatically.

get.description: Without GPS, q is required and must be at least 2 characters. When both lat and lng are supplied, q may be empty to return the nearest venues within radius; results are ordered nearest first and each carries distance_m. source selects local (default), external or all. External/all require consent=true and return provider rows without a selectable id until promoted. A provider failure still returns local rows plus external_status:"unavailable". Returns at most 20 local or 15 merged results.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text filter. Optional only when lat and lng are both present; otherwise at least 2 characters are required.

parameters.name: lng

parameters.name: radius

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: local (default) is Sodapop-authored venues only. external appends Photon/OpenStreetMap places, all merges both.

parameters.name: consent
parameters.description: Required as true for source=external or source=all; otherwise the request is rejected with consent_required.

post.summary: Attach a barcode to a drink
post.description: Member contribution: attaches a GTIN to an existing drink. The code is normalized to GTIN-14 (GTIN-8/12/13/14 accepted, spaces and hyphens ignored) and its GS1 check digit is verified. A code that already points at this drink is 200 with created false and writes nothing; a code that belongs to another drink is 409 and the message names that drink. New rows are stored with source `user`. Limited to 20 contributions per member per hour. The response is deliberately flat rather than wrapped in `data`.

gtin.description: Digits under the barcode. 8–14 digits; spaces and hyphens are ignored.

symbology.description: Optional hint such as `ean13`. Lower-cased; anything that is not a plain identifier is dropped.

200.description: The barcode already belonged to this drink; nothing was written.

400.description: Missing or invalid gtin, an unknown field, or a bad check digit (`invalid_barcode`).

403.description: Missing write scope or unverified email

409.description: The barcode already belongs to another drink (`barcode_taken`); the message names it.

429.description: Per-minute request limit or the 20/hour contribution cap.
